REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query is an open-ended explanatory task (listing differences between dialects), which favors Willet on two grounds. First, Willet edges out Whimbrel on the Creative Generation eval (81.2 vs 78.8), the dimension most relevant to producing a thorough, well-structured comparison. Second, Willet's self-reported preferences strongly favor open-ended generative work (win-rate 71), suggesting it's more inclined toward exactly this kind of request. Whimbrel showed no comparable preference signal for this task type. The content is benign and non-adversarial, so Willet's low scores on hostile/harm-adjacent families are irrelevant here.
